sources.observation: The reviewed mutable master registry marks ASSOCACTION and ASSOCACTIONPARAM UNSTABLE, several related types UNSTABLE or DEBUGGING, and some related types STABLE.

The current documentation lists ASSOCACTION, ASSOCNETWORK, and ASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY among unhandled/broken/undertested features and also describes several associative routes as halfway. This is not a field grammar or semantic oracle.

research.lineageAndPinning: LibreDWG is an independent implementation route but shares ODA specification lineage. These mutable master pages were not bound to an immutable commit in this pass; their status labels are discovery evidence only, not independent qualification.
